title: Intermittent "No Response from API" error with auto-retry (since ~June 17)
body:
Since around June 17 I've been getting an intermittent **"No Response from API"** error in Claude Code. It appears as a red message, auto-retries after ~5–10s, and then continues normally. It seems to hit roughly every other request, which adds up to a significant slowdown over a session.

- Claude Code: 2.1.183
- OS: macOS 15.7.7
- Hardware: MacBook Pro (Intel Core i9)
author: danedwardsdeveloper
